Definition: , or (before a vowel οὕτως adverb from G3778; in this way (referring to what precedes or follows):--after that, after (in) this manner, as, even (so), for all that, like(-wise), no more, on this fashion(-wise), so (in like manner), thus, what.
BiblicalUsage: hoútō is a plain word for in this way, thus, so. In Matthew 1:18, the text says "Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise."
TheologicalSignificance: In hoútō I find no hidden theology; it simply means in this way, thus, so.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Faith; Christian Life
RelatedEvents: The Birth of Jesus; The Angel Appears to Joseph; The Magi Visit Jesus
